:::note[このページについて]
[s1000d-writer-mcp](/s1000d-stack/ja/mcp/writer-mcp/) 0.6.0 の `tools/list` の応答から生成したページです。設定のしかたと応答の読み方は、s1000d-writer-mcp のページにあります。
:::

## 概要

データモジュールから、人が読む文（題名・段落・手順・警告・表のセル・図の題）を翻訳用に取り出します。インライン要素は `{1}` `{2}` の記号に置き換え、骨組みの照合に使う `skeletonHash` を返します

## `tools/list` が返す説明

LLM が受け取る説明の原文（英語）です。

> Take the sentences that a person reads out of a data module so they can be translated: titles, paragraphs, step texts, warnings / cautions / notes, table cells and figure captions. Each segment has a stable id, its XPath, a context hint and the text, with inline elements (emphasis, references …) replaced by {1}, {2} placeholders that must stay in the translation. Attribute values, DMCs, ICNs, applicability expressions and ids are never offered. Also returns the skeletonHash to pass to apply_segments. The server does not translate and does not score translations.

## 引数

`inputSchema` の内容です。入れ子の引数は `親.子`、配列の要素は `親[].子` と書いています。説明は原文（英語）です。

| 名前 | 型 | 必須 | 値の制約 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` |  |  | File path of the document. |
| `xml` | `string` |  |  | An existing document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB). Not for XML you wrote yourself: build new data modules with build_data_module. |
| `include` | `array<string>` |  |  | Which kinds of sentences to return (default: all). |
| `maxSegments` | `integer` |  | ≥ 0 | Cap on the number of segments returned. |
